description: TXN-FLUSH-COMMIT, dbUserCommitSync = "No" without a kill. On the big fixture: BeginTrans, the INSERT...SELECT, the file's size and hash, CommitTrans and the file read right after and every 50 ms for 500 ms; then SetOption(58, "No") and the same sequence; then SetOption(58, "Yes") and the same sequence. Asks whether the commit is in the file at the return of CommitTrans under each setting and when it appears.
